Bound explicit qualification concurrency keys

Nine explicit syscall targets exceeded GitHub's 400-character
concurrency-group limit, so the workflow failed before creating a job.

Use the run ID for explicit build, test and benchmark selections. This
keeps their keys bounded and prevents distinct selections from cancelling
each other. Named qualification lanes retain their existing grouping.

Assisted-by: Codex
